utility.new_design: expected normalized Pareto area gained by a measured outcome
utility.independent_repeat: expected absolute area change when an independent group updates this design's mean
utility.batch: include in-support new pending/selected predictive means as temporary frontier points; downweight nearby designs
utility.score: expected area utility * local makeability probability * diversity factor / cost
utility.reference: measured minima minus 10% of spans; spans are measured ranges floored at 0.05 fraction and 0.5 kJ/m2
utility.makeability: Beta(1,1) local kernel estimate, Gaussian width 0.35 in design space, one effective vote per preparation
utility.diversity: 1 - exp(-distance^2 / (2 * 0.20^2)); minimum distance to a pending or selected design
utility.prediction: paired within-design observation draws, with transmission utility saturated to [0,1] and toughness floored at zero

limits: Model-based, uncalibrated outcome and makeability uncertainty.
Greedy cost efficiency is approximate; pending mean fantasies assume successful makes and do not model joint batch covariance.
Confirmation utility measures movement in the observed frontier; it can value measurement scatter. It is not expected reduction in posterior loss.

assumptions: Choose one shortlisted recipe. Fixed fictional utility = 0.5*transmission + 0.5*toughness/(toughness+5 kJ/m²).
Assay credit_cost is in the same utility units; it is separate from the batch-planning budget.
One assay reports one of up to eight supplier-property intervals accurately. No later assay is priced.
Stock cards are independent across recipes. Within-card conditional Gaussian draws retain supplier correlations.
Utility averages the complete-card predictor before and after revealing an interval. Acquisition of a value does not change the material.
Missing fields are treated as unreported supplier properties; informative selection or assay error would require another observation model.
Finite quadrature retains up to 128 positive, in-support cards from 1024 proposals and requires 16 if sampling is needed.
The working posterior and assay values are uncalibrated. The calculation concerns the supplied shortlist and this synthetic utility.

formula.marginal: Group-weighted fitted mean and SD when observed descriptors are uninformative.

assumptions: Pairwise Gaussian supplier correlations estimated within eligible training folds.
Each group has unit weight. Group dependence is approximated, not fitted as a random effect.
Working posterior integrates missing-input second moments with empirical response scaling.
Reported uncertainty includes new-run variation; predictive coverage requires fresh groups.

gate_replay.basis: one constructed case per scenario; counts describe this challenge set

method.training_unit: one independent synthetic preparation per row
method.classifier: Class-conditional Gaussians, 20% pooled covariance shrinkage and empirical class priors.
method.selection: Highest calibration coverage passing the simultaneous upper bound; highest threshold breaks ties. Defer all if none pass.
method.bound: One-sided exact binomial upper bounds on error conditional on settling, Bonferroni across the fixed grid.
method.scope: The risk bound concerns fresh independent draws from the calibration generator. Cases routed to review can have a different mix of causes. Calibration for that subset or a physical lab requires new labelled groups from the intended referral process. Shifted scores are descriptive. No registry mutation.
method.loss: Every incorrect settled action incurs one error. Ask defers. Using a compromised result is harmful admission; intervening on a valid result is harmful exclusion. Other settled errors are incorrect remedies.
method.baseline: Fixed rules on the same three signals. A single large check residual and corroborating disagreement triggers intervention; three small residuals permit use; other cases defer.

training_snapshot.snapshot_scope: eligible performance rows, including actual preparation group and design
